design_archetype.name: The High-Energy Broadcast Studio (Swiss & Performance Hybrid)
design_archetype.mode: Light/Dark Hybrid with Red & Dark Blue Primary Accents
design_archetype.vibe: Professional broadcast studio meets modern cloud SaaS. Crisp white cards, energetic YouTube-red accents, deep obsidian/slate backgrounds, high-contrast metrics, and dynamic control panels.
anti_patterns_forbidden: Pure #000000 flat black backgrounds without subtle blue/slate tints
Generic centered layouts with centered text everywhere
Using default Inter for section headlines
Placeholder image URLs from external dummy generators
Unstyled raw browser select boxes or date pickers

typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none
scale.caption: text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500

layout_and_spacing.spacing_philosophy: Generous spacing philosophy (2-3x default padding). Cards must have minimum p-6 to p-8 padding to avoid collisions.
layout_and_spacing.stepper_card_layout: Max-width centered wizard card (max-w-4xl) with crisp top navigation pills: 1. YouTube & Key | 2. Stream Source | 3. Go Live Studio. Active pill highlighted in solid Red (#E50914) with white bold text.
layout_and_spacing.bottom_toolbar_grid: Horizontal bar featuring action icon pills: Tips, Landscape, Video quality FHD, FPS 60, Overlay, Teams, Replay, More, alongside a prominent Red 'Next / Go Live' action button.

Header.details: Sticky header with visual crystal glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 z-50). Displays CreatorLive24/7 logo with animated Red LIVE badge, main nav links (Wizard, Studio, Video Library, Monetization), Google Email Login button / User menu, and Theme Switcher.

HeroSection.details: High-impact banner inspired by screenshot 2. Banner: 'CreatorLive24/7 — Your Content. Always On.' Blue/white brand theme, red LIVE badge, yellow accent highlight. Tagline: 'Go Live Faster. Stream Smarter. Grow 24/7.'. Quick launch CTA buttons to YouTube & Facebook live studio wizard.

LiveSetupWizard.details:
Interactive 3-step live streaming setup wizard adhering to screenshot 1:
- Step 1: YouTube & Facebook RTMP Key setup (Platform selector, Stream URL, Stream Key toggle visibility, save destination settings).
- Step 2: Stream Source configuration (Options: Stream Camera preview, Screen Broadcast modal, Video file selector with 'Choose Video from Device' purple button and 'Open Video Studio' red button; Bottom toolbar with Tips, Landscape toggle, Quality FHD 1080p, 60 FPS indicator, Watermark Overlay toggle, Teams invite, Replay loop mode, More options, and big Red Next button).
- Step 3: Go Live Studio (Full live broadcast console with video preview, real-time FPS/bitrate meter, live timer 00:00:00, live chat feed simulation, platform sync status badge for YouTube & Facebook, Stop/Go Live toggle button).

VideoLibrary.details: Cloud storage video library for 24/7 stream loops. Features file dropzone upload, clip preview cards, resolution badge, cloud storage quota indicator, 24/7 Auto-Loop toggle switch, and stream shortcut to immediately use clip in Step 2 of setup wizard.

MonetizationAndFeatures.details: Feature breakdown highlighting Live Streaming, Video Library, 24/7 Loop Streaming, and Monetization Guide (Ad revenue, Super Chats, Sponsorships). Includes platform integration badges for YouTube and Facebook.

Footer.details: Footer featuring location address: 'Tripoliya, Patna, Bihar, India', platform badges (YouTube, Facebook), quick navigation links, and the dark-blue bottom feature strip: 'Fast Setup / Secure & Reliable / Build Your Audience / Monetize Smarter'.

GoogleAuthModal.details: Modal simulating Google Email ID Single Sign-On flow with profile avatar display and account session management.

testing_attributes.rule: Every interactive element (button, input, tab, link, toggle, modal trigger) MUST include a unique data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Use JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components, matching the existing project structure.
Never default to plain Inter font for headings; import Outfit / Clash Display and JetBrains Mono.
Strictly follow the 3-step wizard structure from Screenshot 1: 1. YouTube & Key | 2. Stream Source | 3. Go Live Studio with red active pill pills style.
Provide interactive mock capabilities for video stream preview, camera switching, screen broadcast simulation, RTMP key validation, video file selection, and fake live timer.
Include Google Email ID sign-in state handling in state management / context so creators can toggle logged-in states.
Ensure Tripoliya, Patna, Bihar, India location details are accurately reflected in footer and company info cards.
All buttons must have explicit hover states with text color defined (e.g. hover:bg-red-700 hover:text-white).
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive and key data display elements.
